 Daniel Lewis See More A potential Finals preview takes place on the Thursday NBA schedule as the New York Knicks visit the Minnesota Timberwolves. The reigning champion Knicks (8-6) are aiming for their third straight win after a two-game sweep of Toronto earlier this week. The Timberwolves (11-4) are also seeking a third straight victory after they completed a two-game sweep of their own with back-to-back wins over Portland on Monday and Tuesday. The teams split their two matchups last season with the home team winning each. Jonathan Kuminga (shoulder) is questionable for the Wolves.
